title: The Candy Witch's Halloween
notes: English read-aloud script, same scenes and line order as read_script_el.json (ko text is the clip key, en is what is spoken; voices and acting directions come from voice_script_el.json). Title: The Candy Witch's Halloween. Child: Dahyun (girl). The witch is 'the Candy Witch', the cat is 'Pumpkin'. Natural read-aloud English, UK spelling 'colour' as in the catalogue line. Round block: scenes with round/variant are played only when that result is picked for that round (rounds=2, no repeats). See ko notes for the engine change. [2026-10-29] Colour quiz lines removed; after the stir line the pot pops and a narrator result line ("Red and blue mixed together made purple!" / "Only red went in, so it became a red strawberry candy!") follows the Pop line. Friends-only chorus lines removed. Same-background scenes continue without a page turn. [2026-10-29 line review] Scene 3 ingredient intro and "Snot and poo?" removed; after the drop line, kid says "Eww! Snot?"/"Eww! Poo?" only when snot/poo went in. Witch greeting trimmed (hat sentence cut). Kid "Yes! I want to do it!" key text changed to 네, 제가 할게요!.

variants.rule: 회전 n 에서는 variant 가 없는 장면 + variant == chosen[n-1] 인 round==n 장면만 재생. chosen 은 keys 에서 중복 없이 무작위 2개(?mix=pumpkin,bat 로 고정, localStorage 로 지난번에 본 결과를 뒤로).

lines.text: 핼러윈 밤이에요. 바람을 타고 무언가 팔랑팔랑 날아왔어요.

segs: It's Halloween night. Something came fluttering, fluttering on the wind.

lines.en: Oh? An invitation! There's a cauldron and candy on it!

segs: At the end of the street, the candy shop window lit up bright.

lines.text: 어서 와, 친구들! 나는 사탕 마녀야.

segs: Come in, come in, friends! I'm the Candy Witch.

segs: Dahyun and her friends scurried right into the candy shop.

lines.text: 오늘은 핼러윈 특별 사탕을 만들 거야. 먼저 솥을 끓여야지.
lines.en: Today we're making special Halloween candy. First, we have to get the cauldron bubbling.
segs: Today we're making special Halloween candy. First, we have to get the cauldron bubbling.

lines.en: Dahyun popped a tiny spark onto the firewood.
segs: Dahyun popped a tiny spark onto the firewood.

lines.text: 화르륵! 불이 활활, 솥이 뽀글뽀글 끓기 시작했어요.
lines.en: Whoosh! The fire blazed, and the cauldron began to bubble, bubble, bubble.
segs: Whoosh! The fire blazed, and the cauldron began to bubble, bubble, bubble.

lines.en: Meow!
Nya... stinky!

lines.text: 히히, 색을 섞으면 다른 색 사탕이 돼. 먹으면 어떻게 되는지는… 비밀! 같이 만들까?

segs: Dahyun dropped the green frog and the blue wave into the cauldron. Ribbit, splosh!

lines.text: 하나, 둘! 솥 물이 빙글빙글 돌며 색이 변했어요.
lines.en: One, two! The cauldron water swirled round and round, and its colour changed.
segs: One, two! The cauldron water swirled round and round, and its colour changed.

lines.en: Here we go, stir, stir. Bubble, bubble...
segs: Here we go, stir, stir. Bubble, bubble...

lines.en: Pop! Candies came popping out of the cauldron.
segs: Pop! Candies came popping out of the cauldron.

lines.en: Green and blue mixed together made green!
segs: Green and blue mixed together made green!

lines.en: Yum... it's frog candy!
Poof! Dahyun turned into a green frog!
segs: Poof! Dahyun turned into a green frog!

lines.en: Ribbit! Hop, all the way up to the roof!
segs: Ribbit! Hop, all the way up to the roof!

lines.en: Poof! Dahyun was back to normal.
segs: Poof! Dahyun was back to normal.

lines.en: This time, shall we try a different colour?
segs: This time, shall we try a different colour?

lines.en: Dahyun dropped the red fire truck and the green dinosaur into the cauldron. Nee-naw nee-naw, rawr!
segs: Dahyun dropped the red fire truck and the green dinosaur into the cauldron. Nee-naw nee-naw, rawr!

segs: Red and green mixed together made brown!

lines.en: Yum... it's chocolate candy!

lines.text: 뿅! 다현이 입에 초콜릿 수염이 났어요!
lines.en: Poof! Dahyun grew a chocolate moustache!
segs: Poof! Dahyun grew a chocolate moustache!

lines.en: Drip, drip... I'm melting!
Poof! Dahyun was back to normal.
segs: Poof! Dahyun was back to normal.

lines.text: 마지막은 핼러윈 특별 사탕! 색을 전부 다 넣는 거야. 다 같이!
lines.en: Last of all, the special Halloween candy! We put in every single colour. All together!
segs: Last of all, the special Halloween candy! We put in every single colour. All together!

lines.en: Every single one?
Dahyun dropped them in one by one. Plop, plop, plop, plop!
segs: Dahyun dropped them in one by one. Plop, plop, plop, plop!

lines.text: 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷! 색을 전부 섞으면…
lines.en: One, two, three, four! When you mix all the colours...
segs: One, two, three, four! When you mix all the colours...

lines.en: Bubble, bubble... POP!
Out came a black candy!
Huh? My lips turned black! It's ghost candy!
segs: Huh? My lips turned black! It's ghost candy!

lines.en: Oooh... oooh...
Hee hee, me too!
The witch, Pumpkin the cat and the friends, all with black lips...
segs: The witch, Pumpkin the cat and the friends, all with black lips...

lines.en: Oooh... oooh...

lines.text: 유령 흉내를 내며 마을을 한 바퀴 돌았어요. 하나도 안 무서워요, 다 웃고 있거든요.
lines.en: They marched around the village pretending to be ghosts. Not scary at all, because everyone was laughing.
segs: They marched around the village pretending to be ghosts. Not scary at all, because everyone was laughing.

lines.text: 자, 약속! 남은 사탕 다 나와라!
lines.en: Now, as promised! All the leftover candy, come on out!
segs: Now, as promised! All the leftover candy, come on out!

lines.text: 솥에서 사탕이 퐁퐁퐁 쏟아졌어요. 모두 하나씩… 마녀는 두 개!
lines.en: Candy came pouring out of the cauldron, pop, pop, pop. One for everyone... and two for the witch!
segs: Candy came pouring out of the cauldron, pop, pop, pop. One for everyone... and two for the witch!

lines.en: Hee hee, two for me!

lines.text: 뿅, 뿅, 뿅! 딸기, 개구리, 오리, 박쥐, 물고기, 호박… 다 같이 변신!
lines.en: Poof, poof, poof! Strawberry, frog, duck, bat, fish, pumpkin... everyone changed together!
segs: Poof, poof, poof! Strawberry, frog, duck, bat, fish, pumpkin... everyone changed together!

lines.en: Poof! Everyone back to normal.

lines.text: 다현이 덕분에 사탕이 가득! 내년에도 같이 섞자.
lines.en: Thanks to Dahyun, we have candy galore! Let's mix again next year.
segs: Thanks to Dahyun, we have candy galore! Let's mix again next year.

lines.en: Yes! Next time, with different colours!
segs: Yes! Next time, with different colours!

lines.text: 다현이가 사탕 마녀 손을 잡고 폴짝 뛰었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun took the Candy Witch's hand and hopped for joy.
segs: Dahyun took the Candy Witch's hand and hopped for joy.

lines.en: Happy Halloween! Oooh!
